scientific_limitations: Only the geometric Mordell-Weil group over algebraically closed constants is classified at minimum height.
No rank over Q(t), no higher-height census, no resolution of the original Brahmagupta problem.
The coefficient Galois group is proved a 2-group without determining its exact order.
A historical implicit specialization of generic Shioda formulas remains a residual priority risk.
title: Three radical packets and the complete minimum-height section census of Brahmagupta's elliptic curve
